contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::cancelReservation(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		u: User = User.allInstances()->any(x: User|x.UserID = uid),
		c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(x: BookCopy|x.Barcode = barcode),
		r: Reserve = Reserve.allInstances()->any(x: Reserve|x.ReservedUser = u and
		x.ReservedCopy = c and
		x.IsReserveClosed = false)
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->exists(x: User|x.UserID = uid) and
		BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(x: BookCopy|x.Barcode = barcode) and
		c.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
		c.IsReserved = true and
		Reserve.allInstances()->exists(x: Reserve|x.ReservedUser = u and
		x.ReservedCopy = c and
		x.IsReserveClosed = false)
	postcondition:
		c.IsReserved = false and
		r.IsReserveClosed = true and
		result = true
}
